report_title: ETH/USDT PERPETUAL 15m — Market Behaviour Edge Discovery Report
report_title_zh: ETH-USDT-SWAP 15m 市场行为边缘发现报告

dsl_feature_gap_and_proxies.native_allowlist_note: DSL FEATURES lack true VWAP/VP/funding/OI/delta/orderflow/session. Must inject honest OHLCV proxies process-locally.

proxies.name: utc_hour
proxies.honesty: exact session clock; not liquidity depth

proxies.name: session_liq
proxies.definition: 1.0 if utc_hour in [7,20) else 0.0 (London–NY overlap proxy)
proxies.honesty: calendar liquidity gate only; not L2 depth

proxies.name: sess_vwap_dist
proxies.definition: (close - session_vwap_utc_day) / atr14; session_vwap = cum(typical*rng)/cum(rng) from 00:00 UTC using range as volume proxy
proxies.honesty: range-weighted VWAP proxy when true volume missing; NOT exchange VWAP

proxies.name: va_pos
proxies.definition: position of close in rolling 96-bar (24h) high-low: (close-low96)/(high96-low96)
proxies.honesty: crude value-area location; not volume-profile VAH/VAL/POC

proxies.name: poc_proxy
proxies.definition: rolling 96-bar mid of densest price bin by bar-count (OHLC mid histogram)
proxies.honesty: time-at-price POC proxy, not volume POC

proxies.name: delta_proxy
proxies.honesty: candle body/range aggression proxy; not true CVD/tick delta

proxies.name: cvd_slope4
proxies.honesty: path-dependent OHLCV delta path; not exchange cumulative volume delta

proxies.name: absorb_score
proxies.honesty: failed-auction / absorption morphology from OHLC only

proxies.name: sweep_reclaim
proxies.definition: wick beyond prev_high20/prev_low20 then close back inside prior range

proxies.name: vol_pulse
proxies.definition: vol_z20 if present else z-score of (high-low) over 20
proxies.honesty: activity pulse; true volume preferred when parquet has it

proxies.name: effort_result
proxies.definition: range_sum_3 / abs(close-close.shift(3)) — high effort low progress = absorption regime

proxies.name: funding_skew
proxies.definition: funding_rate_per_8h from factory friction meta if fetchable; else NaN→skip branch
proxies.honesty: only use if live/cached funding available; do NOT invent from RSI

proxies.name: oi_proxy
proxies.definition: if OI series fetchable: oi_z20 + price_stall; else mark unavailable and kill OI-dependent edges in Death Test

dsl_feature_gap_and_proxies.filter_only_indicators_policy: rsi14/macd_stick/ema*/z20/cci may appear ONLY as soft regime filters (wide bands), never as the causal edge. Prefer zero traditional indicators in entry skeleton.

cl_archive_lessons_absorbed: 勿过窄单阈值 → trades<10 → WF folds不足
勿边际 exhaustion（rsi刚过线）→ 硬止损簇 ≈-22% → friction Sharpe崩
softening 参数必须同时挡住新硬止损 + logic_destruction±20%
extreme friction 崩盘主因是硬止损簇，不是单纯滑点叠加
禁止 CL 15m exhaustion_fade 同构
目标样本与稳定性优先：opens/day 0.5–1.0（≈每1–2天1笔）而非刷单

known_live_collisions_to_avoid.avoid: 超买衰竭空 / RSI+z+macd翻负同构
单纯斜率/ribbon推进当作行为边
任何触碰这些标的或同构搬迁

directions.thesis_zh: 伦敦开盘后首个完整拍卖段出现买方接受（收盘位于15m区间上半+正向delta_proxy），且不在亚洲尾盘虚假冲高之后——参与度脉冲确认后顺拍卖方向做多。
directions.entry_sketch_proxy: session_liq>0; utc_hour>=7; utc_hour<10; delta_proxy>0.15; va_pos>0.55; vol_pulse>0.3; absorb_score<0.5
directions.exit_sketch: va_pos>0.85 take_profit OR sweep_reclaim against OR max_hold=16
directions.causal_entry: 开盘拍卖接受价（买盘愿意在区间上沿成交）而非指标超买/突破追价
directions.causal_exit: 价值区顶端过度延伸或反向扫流动性失效
directions.why_not_banned_edge: 非EMA/MACD/RSI边；非趋势突破/均值回归核心；非ETH15m fade衰竭空

directions.thesis_zh: 价格在会话VWAP上方被接受（连续≥2根收盘>vwap且sess_vwap_dist∈小正区间），非远离后回归——行为是接受溢价交易而非均值回归。
directions.micro_behavior: sess_vwap_dist∈[0.15,1.1]; 连续收盘在vwap上; vol_pulse中等
directions.entry_sketch_proxy: session_liq>0; sess_vwap_dist>0.15; sess_vwap_dist<1.1; delta_proxy>0; vol_pulse>-0.2; vol_pulse<1.8
directions.causal_entry: 机构会话定价锚上方接受，趋势尚未耗尽
directions.why_not_banned_edge: VWAP接受≠mean-reversion到VWAP；禁止做空远离VWAP的回归单

directions.thesis_zh: 24h价值区上沿（va_pos>0.88）出现拒绝形态（上影/absorb_score高）且delta_proxy翻负——拍卖失败后回到价值区内。
directions.causal_entry: 价值区边缘拍卖失败（卖方主导收盘）
directions.causal_exit: 重新接受上沿外=失败空头
directions.why_not_banned_edge: 拒绝的是价值区边缘行为，不是RSI超买衰竭；与ETH15m fade条件集正交

directions.thesis_zh: 向下扫过prev_low20后收回区间（sweep_reclaim=1），effort_result显示扫流动性后卖方努力失效——行为是止损猎取后回收。
directions.micro_behavior: 低点刺破+收盘收回+随后正delta
directions.causal_entry: 流动性sweep后主动买盘回收
directions.why_not_banned_edge: 非range_reclaim指标版；核心是sweep形态+回收，不是EMA回收
directions.novelty_hint: medium-high — must differ from BNB session_v_reclaim dump→reclaim

directions.thesis_zh: 连续上行努力（3棒range大）但净进度小（effort_result高）且absorb_score升高——买方努力无结果，随后空头释放。
directions.micro_behavior: 高effort低progress + 中位收盘吸收
directions.causal_entry: 努力无结果=吸收后的供应释放
directions.why_not_banned_edge: 不是RSI顶背离；是range努力/结果微观结构

directions.thesis_zh: UTC13–16（伦敦尾/纽约初）参与度脉冲（vol_pulse上穿）伴随正delta且价格在POC代理上方——仅交易高参与重叠窗。
directions.micro_behavior: 重叠窗+活动脉冲+方向一致
directions.entry_sketch_proxy: utc_hour>=13; utc_hour<16; vol_pulse>0.8; delta_proxy>0.2; close>poc_proxy; session_liq>0
directions.causal_entry: 重叠时段知情/主动流涌入
directions.causal_exit: 脉冲消退或失去POC上方接受
directions.why_not_banned_edge: 时钟+参与度行为边，非指标交叉

directions.thesis_zh: UTC日开盘前4根（00–01）形成Opening Range后，向上假破OR高点并收回OR内（failed break）——行为失效突破。
directions.entry_sketch_proxy: or_failed_up>0; delta_proxy<0; utc_hour>=1; utc_hour<8; close<or_high; vol_pulse>0
directions.causal_entry: 开盘区间假突破后的拍卖失败
directions.why_not_banned_edge: failed break是行为/拍卖失败，不是trend_breakout追破；方向常与突破策略相反
directions.freq_risk: 可能略低于0.5/日 — Death Test需检查样本；必要时放宽OR定义而非加RSI

directions.thesis_zh: 价格创新低但cvd_slope4抬升（卖压钝化）后出现正delta翻转——路径依赖的订单流代理背离释放。
directions.micro_behavior: 低点+CVD代理背离+翻转确认
directions.causal_entry: 被动卖出吸收后主动买回
directions.traditional_indicators_role: forbidden to substitute RSI divergence — must use cvd_slope4 proxy
directions.why_not_banned_edge: 明确禁止伪装成RSI背离；edge是delta路径

directions.thesis_zh: 若可获取funding：极端正资金费率拥挤后，15m出现负delta+va_pos高位拒绝——拥挤多头减仓驱动。
directions.micro_behavior: funding极端 + 行为拒绝确认
directions.exit_sketch: funding_skew normalize OR va_pos<0.45; invalidation close>prev_high20; max_hold=16
directions.causal_entry: 拥挤仓位的强制/主动去杠杆
directions.traditional_indicators_role: none; funding is positioning not RSI
directions.why_not_banned_edge: 定位/资金费边；若funding不可取则Death Test直接淘汰本方向

directions.thesis_zh: 若OI可取：OI上升而价格净进度停滞（effort_result高）——杠杆堆积无趋势，随后向下释放概率升。
directions.micro_behavior: OI↑ + 价格停滞 + 负delta触发
directions.exit_sketch: oi_z20<0 OR effort_result<1.0; invalidation prev_high20; max_hold=16
directions.causal_entry: 杠杆堆积无法推升价格后的多杀多
directions.why_not_banned_edge: OI行为；无OI则淘汰，禁止用atr/rsi假装OI

directions.thesis_zh: 亚洲时段（utc 0–6）累计正delta推升后，伦敦开盘（7–9）出现inventory transfer：高va_pos + 负delta翻转——亚洲多头库存向欧美移交时的抛压。
directions.micro_behavior: 亚洲推升残留 + 伦敦负流
directions.entry_sketch_proxy: asia_push_flag>0; utc_hour>=7; utc_hour<10; delta_proxy< -0.1; va_pos>0.65; vol_pulse>0.2
directions.why_not_banned_edge: 跨会话库存行为，非指标均值回归

directions.thesis_zh: 价值区内（va_pos∈[0.35,0.65]）波动压缩后（atr14/atr_ma低）伴随vol_pulse回升与正delta——平衡市内部的参与度恢复，而非突破追价。
directions.entry_sketch_proxy: va_pos>0.35; va_pos<0.65; atr_compress>0; vol_pulse_up>0; delta_proxy>0.1; session_liq>0
directions.exit_sketch: va_pos>0.8 take_profit; atr_compress失效且delta翻负 invalidation; max_hold=16
directions.causal_entry: 平衡区内流动性回来后的短促方向选择
directions.causal_exit: 再平衡失败或过度延伸出VA
directions.traditional_indicators_role: atr14 only as compression measure; not ADX
directions.why_not_banned_edge: 不是vol-contraction→breakout（ETH1h禁撞）；明确禁止prev_high突破入场，只做VA内参与度恢复
directions.novelty_hint: medium — must hard-ban breakout entry leaf
directions.diff_vs_eth1h_breakout: ETH1h用收缩后破结构；本边禁止破prev_high入场，只做价值区内脉冲

directions.thesis_zh: 连续≥4根阳线但实体递减（body_shrink）且累计delta增速放缓、末棒出现上影吸收——单边主动买盘耗尽的行为翻转。
directions.causal_entry: 主动买盘耗尽后的供应入场
directions.traditional_indicators_role: STRICT BAN on rsi14/macd as entry — morphology only
directions.why_not_banned_edge: 与ETH15m fade正交：禁用rsi/z/macd/ema16骨架；只用K线质量+delta
directions.novelty_hint: medium — collision risk with fade if repaired toward RSI

directions.thesis_zh: 时间价POC代理上移（poc_proxy rising）且收盘持续在POC上方——价值迁移跟随，而非突破追高。
directions.entry_sketch_proxy: poc_slope4>0; close>poc_proxy; sess_vwap_dist>0; delta_proxy>0; session_liq>0; va_pos<0.85
directions.causal_entry: 市场价值中心迁移后的接受
directions.why_not_banned_edge: 价值迁移≠EMA趋势边；入场不依赖ema排列
